verdict.rationale: Datalab's convert API and SDK document a first-party "chunks" output format alongside Markdown, HTML and JSON, so pre-chunked output is a real product capability. The evidence never describes how chunks are bounded, what metadata they carry, or whether they are sized for embedding. The separate segmentation endpoint only returns page ranges for logical sections, which is a different feature from RAG chunking. Missing for 10: documentation of semantic chunk boundaries, per-chunk metadata, embedding-ready sizing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, output comes pre-chunked for RAG — semantic boundaries, metadata, embedding-ready segments — not a wall of text
